title: AC1027 Cover ODA GUI-session launch attempt
scope: Use the installed ODA File Converter through Launch Services in the active Aqua session, avoiding the previously failing direct CLI launch; determine whether document processing starts.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local source; no DWG/DXF fixture or derivative was added to Git.

converter.result: Launch Services failed before starting the converter: kLSNoExecutableErr (NSOSStatusErrorDomain Code -10827). The app bundle names the existing executable, but no converter process or document processing was observed.

decision: This is the single changed GUI-session launch attempt after prior direct CLI pasteboard/XPC failures. Do not retry the same app through Launch Services or repeat direct CLI launches. The AC1027 HEADER suffix remains unclaimed and strict output remains refused; reopen converter work only after the Launch Services registration or launch environment materially changes, or an independent converter session becomes available.
